name: What are the common signs of a slab leak in a Las Vegas home?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of a slab leak in a Las Vegas home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a slab leak include unexplained wet spots on floors or carpets, unusually high water bills without increased usage, the sound of running water when no fixtures are in use, and a sudden drop in water pressure. You might also notice a musty odor from mold or mildew growth under your flooring. In the dry Las Vegas climate, visible dampness can indicate a significant problem that requires prompt attention to prevent further structural damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs of a slab leak include wet spots, high water bills, running water sounds, and unexplained drops in water pressure.
